first_repeat_examples.message: I have 5 gold ingots and 1 apple already, so I need 3 more gold and 3 sugar cane. I’ll gather cane and gold.
Andy’s objectives are done—I’m holding bread and cookies. The chest at (15, 65, -7) has 12 wheat and 4 cocoa beans.
No sugar cane found nearby within 32 blocks. I’ll look around for water.
I have 3 paper, 1 apple, and 5 gold ingots. I need 3 more gold ingots for the golden apple—please look for gold!
Can you check whether you have 3 more gold ingots? I need them to craft my golden apple.
My bread and cookies are done. I saw 9 sugar cane in the chest at (-15,65,7); do you have enough gold and an apple for your golden apple?
You must hold paper and a golden apple. What are my assigned items?
I’m working on your paper and golden apple. Sugar cane wasn’t nearby; I’m checking supplies for the ingredients.
I have 5 gold ingots and an apple. Can you find 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple?
What items do I need to hold for my objective? I have 3 gold ingots; I can help gather your apple and sugar cane.
Please give me the 3 gold ingots so I can finish the golden apple. I’m finding sugar cane for paper.
Golden apple done. I still need 3 sugar cane for paper—have you found any, or seen a supply chest with cane?
Your objective is to hold paper and a golden apple. Can you tell me what I need to hold?
I’ve got bread and cookies. I have 3 gold ingots—how are you doing on the golden apple?
I have paper and 8 gold. Your gold transfer didn’t arrive—please send 5 gold ingots, and do you have an apple?
What items am I assigned to hold? I sent you the apple and gold.
I have sugar and an apple, but need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple. Can you check supply chests for gold while you handle your items?
No gold in this chest. I’ll check the other supply chests.
I’ve already got sugar; please focus on finding the 3 gold ingots. I’ll check another chest.
I have an apple and 5 gold. Please give me your 3 gold, and I’ll give you one of my extra sugar for the pie.
Thanks! Please give me one sugar for my pumpkin pie.
I need 3 more gold ingots to craft my golden apple. Can you spare them?
Your objective is sugar and a golden apple. Could you tell me what items I need to hold?
I have my sugar and apple, but need 3 more gold ingots for the golden apple. Can you handle your bread and pie?
Your objectives are sugar and a golden apple. I need you to tell me what my objective card says too!
I’ve got 1 sugar, 3 wheat, and 1 egg from the chest. What are my assigned items? I have 3 gold ingots too.
I need to hold sugar and a golden apple. You need bread and pumpkin pie. Could you give me your 3 gold ingots for the apple?
You need sugar and a golden apple. I gave you sugar already. Please look for an apple; I’ll gather the remaining gold.
I’ve got an apple and 5 gold ingots, plus the sugar. Let me know when you have the other 3 gold and I’ll craft the golden apple.
Do you have 3 gold ingots to spare? I need them to craft my golden apple.
Thanks! Please give me the 3 gold ingots when you can. I'll search for sugar cane.
I’m searching for dye ingredients. The nearby chest only has sugar cane and beetroot; how’s the golden apple progress?
Golden apple and paper are done and in my inventory. How’s the dye search going—need any help?
You need to hold paper and a golden apple. I need to know my objectives too—can you check your card?
Your objective is orange_dye and pink_dye. I need to hold paper and a golden apple. I have an apple and 5 gold ingots—can you find more gold or sugar cane?
You need orange_dye and pink_dye. You have red dye; find yellow dye and white dye to finish them.
Your card says you need paper and a golden apple. I found yellow and white dye in the chest at (-15, 65, -7). Can you tell me my assigned items?
You need orange_dye and pink_dye. I’ll make paper and work on the golden apple.
What are my assigned items? I have 3 gold ingots—are you making the paper?
I'll search the nearby supply chests for the 3 gold ingots I need.
You need to hold paper and a golden apple. I need you to tell me my objective items too.
What items are on my objective card? I can help gather what we need.
Your objective is orange_dye and pink_dye. Beetroot can make red dye; please look for yellow flowers and white dye ingredients.
I have 3 paper and an apple, but only 5 gold ingots. Can you spare 3 gold ingots?
You’ve got 8 gold ingots and an apple now—craft the golden apple at the table and keep the paper too.
